title: Borealis intro
body:
Marcus Lindqvist: We know the close is slow but nobody has put a number on it.
Marcus Lindqvist: Every month the finance team loses a week reconciling spreadsheets by hand and the auditors keep flagging it.
Marcus Lindqvist: I think this could work for us.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Marcus Lindqvist: Sounds good.
summary: Intro call: pain surfaced, little else established.

title: Borealis discovery workshop
body:
Marcus Lindqvist: Month-end close takes us 11 days; we need it under 5 by the next audit.
Priya Natarajan: Do you know who would sign for a purchase of this size?
Marcus Lindqvist: The must-haves are audit trail, SSO and a two-week rollout.
Marcus Lindqvist: There is a process but I would have to check the steps.
Marcus Lindqvist: Every month the finance team loses a week reconciling spreadsheets by hand and the auditors keep flagging it.
Marcus Lindqvist: I have already told my director we should do this and I can set up the meeting.
Marcus Lindqvist: We are also talking to LedgerPro and the incumbent spreadsheet process is the real alternative.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Marcus Lindqvist: Sounds good.
summary: Workshop: metric quantified, criteria listed, competition named; the buyer would not name the budget holder yet.

title: Borealis exec briefing
body:
Marcus Lindqvist: Our CFO signed off the target: close in 5 days by Q4, which she values at about 200k a year in audit and overtime.
Marcus Lindqvist: Marcus has told the board this is his priority for Q3 and he wants to be on the next call.
Marcus Lindqvist: The scoring sheet is agreed: audit trail 40 percent, rollout speed 30, price 30, and we weighted rollout after your demo.
Marcus Lindqvist: Security review first, then a steering committee vote in July, then procurement.
Marcus Lindqvist: Procurement uses a standard MSA and legal turnaround is about ten working days.
Marcus Lindqvist: If we miss the audit deadline again we lose the clean opinion, and that is a covenant issue with the bank.
Marcus Lindqvist: I presented the business case to the exec team on Tuesday and they asked me to bring you in.
Marcus Lindqvist: LedgerPro could not do the audit trail in the demo, so you are the preferred option now.
Priya Natarajan: Thanks, let me summarise what I heard and we can agree the next step.
Marcus Lindqvist: Sounds good.

title: Borealis contract
body:
Marcus Lindqvist: Marcus has told the board this is his priority for Q3 and he wants to be on the next call.
Marcus Lindqvist: Security review is booked for the 8th with Dana, the committee votes on the 22nd and procurement has a two week SLA after that.
Marcus Lindqvist: Ravi in legal has the MSA now and has committed to redlines by Friday.
Marcus Lindqvist: I presented the business case to the exec team on Tuesday and they asked me to bring you in.

summary: Contract email: legal owner and redline date confirmed.
